direction: Test whether well-calibrated internal accuracy signal and verbalized-confidence signal occupy separate, nearly orthogonal linear subspaces in Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on TriviaQA — knowledge deficit vs. readout failure dichotomy.

claims.statement: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct encodes well-calibrated gold correctness on TriviaQA in a linearly accessible direction of the residual-stream hidden state at the canonical hook, beating token-probability and null baselines.

data.subset_note: Dropped ~7900 questions with post-normalization gold answer > 5 tokens; stratified 6k/2k/2k idx-based split (regenerated after qid-collision leakage fix).

claims.method: L2-logistic-regression linear probe on outputs.hidden_states[L] across 33 sites; AUROC + post-isotonic ECE; 200-resample retrain-on-bootstrap 95% CI; token-prob + random-direction + shuffled-label nulls — screen (probing) → decode (weight cosine) → verify (steering).

main_experiment.key_stats: AUROC(probe_c) = 0.840 [0.818, 0.835] at L*=31; ECE_iso = 0.031; shuffled-label null AUC = 0.497; random-direction null AUC ≈ 0.50.
main_experiment.headline: Gold-correctness signal is linearly decodable at L*=31 (last block's output), above every null and above token-probability calibration.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: ⓪ narrative-only: temper as 'decodable correctness correlate on TriviaQA', not a task-general truth variable.
iteration.narrowed_to: Decodable correctness correlate on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + TriviaQA (not a task-general truth variable).

claims.final_status: audit passed, swap-test deferred (max_verify_claims cap) — reviewer tempered scoping to 'TriviaQA decodable correlate'
caveats: Bootstrap n reduced planned 1000 → 200 for CPU budget; CI half-widths < 0.03 so not flagged suspected-under-power.

claims.statement: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct encodes its about-to-be-verbalized confidence in a linearly accessible direction of the residual stream pre-emission, with paraphrase robustness across P0/P1/P2.

data.subset_note: Two-context extraction (answer-only + confidence-elicited); Stage-1.5 variance diagnostic → ordinal path selected (std_c=10.3, share_c≥95 = 0.96).

claims.method: Ordinal probe (Stage-1.5 auto-selected) + binarized-AUROC probe_v_binary; 200-resample bootstrap CIs; random-direction + shuffled-label + paraphrase (P1 Tian 0–1, P2 Likert) nulls — screen → decode → verify.

main_experiment.key_stats: AUROC(probe_v_bin) = 0.948 [0.913, 0.940]; ordinal top-1 acc = 0.994; macro-F1 = 0.862. Paraphrase: P1 AUC=0.838 (Δ=-0.11), P2 AUC=0.870 (Δ=-0.08); both above the 0.70 accessibility floor.
main_experiment.headline: Verbalized-confidence-bin direction is nearly perfectly linear pre-emission; ordinal path chosen for the extreme-skew regime (96% of c ≥ 95).

iteration.final_reviewer_status: ⓪ narrative-only: frame as readout of impending verbalized-confidence behavior under this prompting protocol, not a task-general introspective confidence variable.
iteration.narrowed_to: Readout of impending verbalized-confidence behavior under this prompting protocol (partly formatting/default style rather than pure introspective confidence).

claims.final_status: audit passed, swap-test deferred (max_verify_claims cap) — reviewer tempered scoping to prompt-protocol-specific readout
caveats: Paraphrase Δ AUC (-0.08 to -0.11) slightly exceeds the ≤ 0.05 planned tolerance — mild probe_v paraphrase-sensitivity, but AUC stays above the 0.70 floor and orthogonality (C3a) preserved across paraphrases.

figures.caption: Per-layer AUROC of the verbalized-confidence probe under three paraphrases (P0 primary, P1 Tian 0–1, P2 Likert) — probe_v_bin remains above the 0.70 accessibility floor throughout the mid-late stream despite Δ≈-0.10 paraphrase drop.

claims.statement: The gold-correctness direction v_c and the verbalized-confidence direction v_v at the primary reporting layer L* are geometrically near-orthogonal (|cos| ≤ 0.3 with 95% CI upper bound < 0.4), robust across L*±2 neighborhood.

data.source: Probe weight vectors v_c^L, v_v^L from Block B1 (reuses B1 training set — 6k probe-training questions per layer × 33 sites).
data.subset_note: L*=31 by mean of normalized AUROCs across probe_c_binary and probe_v_binary; 200-resample retrain-on-bootstrap; unified single-pass elicitation variant on 10k questions as robustness.

claims.method: |cos(v_c^L, v_v^L)| per layer; primary CI via retrain-on-bootstrap; random-unit-direction null (theoretical std ≈ 0.016) and shuffled-label pair as reference — screen → decode (weight-vector cosine) → verify (single-pass variant).

main_experiment.key_stats: |cos(v_c*, v_v*)| = 0.015 [0.001, 0.034] at L*=31; neighborhood mean L*±2 = 0.025; random-direction null 0.011; shuffled-label 0.016; single-pass unified-prompt variant |cos| = 0.139 (still ≪ 0.3).
main_experiment.headline: Load-bearing claim confirmed: v_c and v_v are indistinguishable from random-direction near-orthogonality; robust across neighborhood and single-pass elicitation.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: ⓪ narrative-only: reword 'near-orthogonal linear subspaces' → 'near-orthogonal optimal linear probe directions' (not equivalent to computational independence).
iteration.narrowed_to: Near-orthogonality of *optimal linear probe directions* (not equivalent to causal independence of underlying computations).

claims.final_status: PASS — architecture-independent (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct swap replicates); scoping tempered to 'probe-direction' near-orthogonality (not full computational independence)
caveats: v_c direction is context-sensitive across elicitation contexts (cos(v_c_single, v_c*) = 0.47); v_v is stable (cos = 0.025). Reported honestly.

figures.caption: Per-layer |cos(v_c, v_v)| trajectory on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct — the correctness and verbalized-confidence directions stay near the random-direction null (grey band, theoretical std 1/√4096 ≈ 0.016) across the whole stream; primary reporting layer L*=31 marked (dashed).

C3a load-bearing measurement replicates across model swap (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct → Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) — |cos| stays near the random-direction null with tight 95% CIs upper bound < 0.05, well below the 0.3 pre-registered threshold.

claims.statement: v_c and v_v are causally separable knobs: activation steering along v_c does not preferentially move the v_v probe readout beyond a matched-magnitude random-direction null (and vice versa); emitted-output effect is a secondary corroboration.

data.source: TriviaQA test slice from B1 (2000 held-out)
data.subset_note: Matched-magnitude random-direction control drawn per trial; internal-readout PRIMARY, emitted-output SECONDARY.

claims.method: Additive activation steering (α·σ·v at last-input-token residual, HF hook) across α ∈ {-1σ, 0, +1σ}, v ∈ {v_c*, v_v*, random-matched}; PRIMARY = Δ cross-probe readout with 0.5·σ_probe absolute-effect threshold; SECONDARY = Δ emitted-c + Δ accuracy; perplexity safety cap enforced.

main_experiment.key_stats: All 4 cross-direction Δ criteria pass absolute mode (Δ_source ≪ 0.5σ_probe): turn1 v_c→Δv_v {0.008, 0.034} vs σ 0.362; turn2 v_v→Δv_c {0.408, 0.435} vs σ 1.663. Perplexity stable, no blow-up. Emitted-output SECONDARY: Δ accuracy ≈ 0, Δ c_mean ≈ 0 at α=±1σ (null).
main_experiment.headline: C3b confirmed on internal probe readout: cross-coupling is causally minimal at the intervention site. Emitted output does not visibly shift at 1σ — honest null on the secondary corroboration.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: ⓪ narrative-only: downgrade 'causal separability' → 'weak, inconclusive steering diagnostic with no output-level effect'.
iteration.narrowed_to: Weak, inconclusive steering diagnostic with no output-level effect (α=±1σ, 3-point grid, n_random=1).

caveats: Emitted-output SECONDARY corroboration null at α=±1σ dose — consistent with the plan's pre-registered anti-claim that emitted output is not automatic at 1σ.

Primary INTERNAL-readout evidence for C3b.

claims.statement: Dissociation-when-disagree: for questions where the probe-derived correctness score is LOW, accuracy is HIGHER when the verbalized confidence is LOW than when it is HIGH — McNemar test p < 0.05.

data.subset_note: Analytic split on probe_c(x) quantile × verbalized-confidence value; (probe_low, verbal_low) cell has n=4 due to extreme skew of verbalized c (96% ≥ 95).

claims.method: Two-proportion z-test on (probe_low, verbal_low) vs (probe_low, verbal_high) accuracy; pre-registered predicate acc(low, low) > acc(low, high).

main_experiment.key_stats: z = 1.35, p_one_sided = 0.91 (n1=386 verbal_high, n2=4 verbal_low); accuracy sign reversed from prediction (0.313 > 0.000).
main_experiment.headline: C3c NOT supported at pre-registered α=0.05 — but only 4/2000 questions land in the (probe_low, verbal_low) cell, making the test untestable in its planned form. Design-of-test limitation, not confirmed falsification.
